title: Staff a plan through Steer
when: When an accepted plan has runnable work with no owner, or the user asks to pursue that plan.
need: Read the selected plan, live work state and covering authority before staffing; preserve standing decisions and update the durable checkpoint. Reconcile contradictory teaching about Feed versus Steer rather than inventing an extra mandatory step.
surface: Steer entry, scope and loop; public Strategy guidance
gap: Public Strategy says strategy needs Feed to become runnable work; current Steer says not to invoke Feed, while Strategize attributes staffing to the scheduler. Review question: which shipped owner governs each role, and which producer texts must change together?
